editorial:
Imagine you are standing in the middle of a massive crowd in Orlando, Florida, feeling the ground shake as thousands of fans scream for their favorite wrestlers. That is exactly the vibe you get with this pre-show. You get to hang out with the expert analysts and superstars who break down the biggest fights of the night. It is all about that nervous energy and hype that builds up right before the main event starts. You will see plenty of backstage interviews and heated arguments that make you want to jump out of your seat and see who wins the gold.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the high stakes of the opening matches. While it is technically a lead-in show, the action is still top-notch and the drama is dialed up to ten. The only downside is that it can feel a bit long if you just want to get to the main fights. If you are a wrestling fan, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: As the kickoff wraps up, the tension reaches a breaking point. You see the final pre-show matches conclude with high-energy wins that set the mood for the rest of the night. The show ends by transitioning directly into the main WrestleMania event, leaving you on a cliffhanger. It wraps up by reminding you that the biggest rivalries in the company are about to be settled once and for all in the ring.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves professional wrestling and big arena events.
